name: Centennial Airport

runway.v: three runways: 17L/35R about 10,000 ft (about 3,048 m) x 100 ft, 17R/35L 7,001 ft x 75 ft, 10/28 4,800 ft x 75 ft; runway 10 threshold displaced 400 ft

hours.v: control tower open 24 hours; airport operations staffed 24/7

customs.v: US Customs on demand 24/7 at 7601 S. Peoria St., D-16, user-fee based by MTOW; normal hours rotate every 4 weeks (for example Fri-Sun 07:00-22:00, weekdays 07:00-15:00 or 14:00-22:00); clearances outside normal hours are billed at twice the rate
customs.quote: Centennial Airport offers on-demand, 24/7 U.S. Customs services for international arrivals.

noise.v: voluntary noise abatement guidelines; avoid flight training and ILS training 22:00-07:00; jets should use thrust reduction and minimise reverse thrust
noise.quote: Avoid flight training and ILS training operations between 10:00pm and 7:00am.

handling.v: FBOs listed by the airport: jetCenters of Colorado, Modern Aviation, Signature Aviation (North and South)
handling.quote: jetCenters of Colorado, Modern Aviation, Signature Aviation

notes: Read Centennial Airport (Arapahoe County Public Airport Authority, which 'owns and operates Centennial Airport') pages: Airfield Information, Airport Services, Discover KAPA (no dates; footer 2026) and Voluntary Noise Abatement Guidelines (updated 2025); the FAA Know Before You Go sheet posted there confirms 'KAPA Tower Operates 24 Hours'. The airfield table shows '10,0001 ft' for 17L/35R, an obvious typo; I record about 10,000 ft and use 3,048 m (conservative; 1 ft = 0.3048 m). No curfew is stated; the only night item is a voluntary training restraint.
